topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer welcomes students and outlines the learning objectives for the final lecture on cancer therapy.

topics.label: Conventional Cancer Therapies and Cytotoxic Chemotherapy
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine traditional cancer treatment modalities along with their associated systemic toxicities and resistance mechanisms.

topics.label: Exploiting Intrinsic Cancer Cell Vulnerabilities
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe therapeutic strategies designed to exploit specific intrinsic molecular vulnerabilities and DNA repair defects in cancer cells.

topics.label: Kinase Inhibitors and Mechanisms of Resistance
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss the identification and pharmacological inhibition of oncogenic kinases alongside the emergence of drug resistance and adaptive bypass mechanisms.

topics.label: Antibody-Based Cancer Therapies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the design, therapeutic mechanisms, and clinical considerations of monoclonal antibodies and antibody-drug conjugates directed against tumor antigens.

topics.label: Cancer Immunotherapy and T-Cell Activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the role of the immune system in tumor surveillance and the therapeutic approaches developed to reactivate or engineer immune responses against cancer.

topics.label: Progress, Systemic Challenges, and Future Directions in Cancer Treatment
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the broader progress, systemic challenges, and future clinical and ethical perspectives in cancer therapy.
